description:
Import a design FILE as a NEW design — a CE.SDK `.imgly` design file; a Photoshop (`.psd`/`.psb`), InDesign (`.idml`), PowerPoint (`.pptx`) or PDF file; or a plain image or SVG, which becomes a one-page design sized to the image. To make a media file (image/font/video/audio) available for use INSIDE a design instead of becoming one: Use `asset_add` to bring it into the workspace, then apply it inside `edit`.

Source: `{ url }` (http/https), `{ uri }` (a saved design — you get a copy of it — or a file you were given), `{ demo }` (a design bundled with this server — ids: `"cybernews"`) or `{ path }` (absolute local file path).

Every import starts a NEW design, and you work on it from then on: the design you were on is left as it is. To keep working on a saved design itself rather than a copy, use `open` with its `uri`. With only a `title` and no `source`, it starts an empty design: do that for every new design, before you name it or build it.

Returns JSON `{ uri, title, format }` — the new design, unsaved until `export({ format: 'imgly' })` saves it; to continue it later, `open` the `uri` that save returns. Foreign-format imports may add `warnings` (what did not survive — substituted fonts, unsupported features): treat them as your touch-up list — `preview` the pages, then repair with `edit`.

discard.description: Drop the unsaved edits of the design you are on. Set it ONLY when that work is meant to be thrown away (the user said so, or it was a throwaway sketch); otherwise save it first with `export({ format: 'imgly' })`. Never set it by default.

source.description: The design to load. Provide exactly one of `url` (http/https), `uri` (a saved design), `demo` (a bundled demo design), `path` (absolute local file path; Local only).

demo.description: Id of a demo design bundled with this server — a finished design to demonstrate on, with no file and no build required.

path.description: Absolute local file path of the design file. Local-only.

uri.description: The `uri` of a saved design (you get a new design that starts as a copy of it) or of a file you were given.

url.description: http(s) URL of the design file to load.

title.description: Display name for the design once you save it. Defaults to the source file's basename. Without a `source`, starts an empty design under it.

name: import
